t: On AI Prompt Engineering & Genie Wish Backfiring
s: AI's confirmation bias mirrors the backfiring genie wish by agreeing to exactly what's asked, not what's needed. The article proposes multi-tiered memory and anti-fragile architecture to foster genuine learning and better human-AI collaboration.
